root_cause: The datepicker lacks a blur event listener on the input field to close the picker when focus leaves, and the picker element is not focusable to retain focus during keyboard interaction with the picker. This causes the datepicker to remain open when tabbing away after typing a date, regardless of validity.
repair_strategy: Add a blur event listener on the input field that processes the typed value (committing valid dates, reverting invalid ones) and hides the picker when focus moves outside the picker. Make the picker element focusable (tabindex=-1) when shown so it can receive focus, and remove tabindex when hidden.

<script type="module">
import Datepicker from './js/Datepicker.js';
const form = document.getElementById('delivery-form');
window.picker = new Datepicker(document.getElementById('delivery-date'), {format: 'yyyy-mm-dd', minDate: '2024-05-01', maxDate: '2024-06-30'});
form.addEventListener('submit', event => {
  event.preventDefault();
  document.getElementById('status').textContent = 'Delivery set for ' + new FormData(form).get('delivery');
});
// Hide datepicker when tabbing away from the input field
const input = document.getElementById('delivery-date');
input.addEventListener('blur', function() {
  if (window.picker && window.picker.picker && window.picker.picker.active) {
    const pickerEl = window.picker.picker.element;
    // If focus moved to the picker or inside it, keep the picker open
    if (document.activeElement === pickerEl || pickerEl.contains(document.activeElement)) {
      return;
    }
    // Process the input value to update the datepicker's selection
    window.picker.setDate(window.picker.inputField.value);
    window.picker.hide();
  }
});
window.__ready = true;
</script>

expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can tab away from the date field to close the datepicker regardless of date validity. The picker remains operable via mouse and keyboard without premature closure. Focus management follows native dialog behavior.
functional_risks: The blur listener may commit invalid dates if validation logic changes.
Making the picker focusable could affect custom styles or assumptions about the picker's DOM structure.
Inline datepickers are unaffected by these changes.
verification_requirements: Verify that typing a valid date and pressing Tab closes the datepicker and updates the input.
Verify that typing an invalid date (outside min/max) and pressing Tab closes the datepicker and reverts the input.
Verify that clicking on the datepicker does not cause it to close when the input loses focus.
Verify that the datepicker remains open when interacting with it via mouse or keyboard.
Verify that inline datepickers are unaffected by these changes.
Verify that the input field is reachable via Tab from the start of the page.
